escena: SCENE (print inspection, studio in Santiago, morning, NO faces): the photograph is taken LOOKING THROUGH a loupe magnifier resting on a printed proof — the round glass of the loupe fills the centre of the frame and inside it the halftone rosette of the ink is razor sharp and hugely magnified, while everything outside the glass barrel falls away into soft blur and the hard shaft of window light. The loupe barrel is real chrome and glass, with a visible edge and a thin reflection; only two fingers steady it at the frame edge, caught at the instant they press it down onto the sheet to focus. This is REAL optical distortion seen through a real lens, not a digital effect and not a vignette. 100mm macro at f/4, focus on the magnified ink inside the glass. Everything is completely unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.
